notes.title: The Art of War - Gwent-inspired card game is available now
notes.notes:
Since 2020, we've been hard at work on our tactical card game. And now, the day has finally come—we’re thrilled to announce that its development is complete!

Introducing The Art of War: Card Game, a project inspired by the beta version of Gwent from 2017 to 2019. Our small, dedicated team set out not only to recreate what we loved but also to improve upon it, even creating a tabletop version of the game. Have we succeeded? That’s for you, our players, to decide!

You can support our project and get your hands on the tabletop version of the game on Gamefound.
[url=https://gamefound.com/en/projects/brightdawn/the-art-of-war-card-game][h3][u]Tabletop Version on Gamefound
[/u][/h3][/url]

If you're not ready to support us financially just yet, you can still try out the online version of the game on Steam. It’s completely free, with no microtransactions!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1906570/The_Art_of_War_Card_Game/][h3][u][Online Version on Steam][/u][/h3][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37537593/0a049a42d71d951646c1ac9f505e4adc1a262bb2.png[/img]

For those who miss the serene walks through the woods, we have a special treat in store. We’ve already started working on a full sequel to A Walk in the Woods. Of course, it will take time, as we’ve just begun, so we invite you to join our social media channels to stay updated on all our upcoming projects!

[url=https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100089764713056][u][b]Facebook  [/b][/u][/url] [url=https://discord.gg/q7KSv9VP][u][b]Discord  [/b][/u][/url] [url=https://www.instagram.com/brightdawn.official/][u][b]Instagram[/b][/u][/url]

Sincerely yours,
Brightdawn Entertainment

notes.title: The new version and implementation of Default and Beta channels.
notes.notes:
We recently released a major update of the game called the Anniversary Update, which included improvements to lighting and performance. However, the new technologies used in our game did not work correctly with some Windows Mixed Reality and HTC headsets. Today we have released a new patch that should bring graphics and performance improvements to owners of previously unsupported devices. Hooray!

However, we do not guarantee that this patch has fixed all the problems and made it possible to enjoy the virtual experience on all possible VR headsets! In order not to deprive the owners of virtual reality helmets, which are not yet supported by the game, we have created two separate update channels:

[list]
[*] Default - an old version of the game (it was rolled back to versions before the Anniversary Update), which uses the old engine, has low performance, but can be played on almost any VR device.
[*] Beta - a new version of the game, with a new engine that provides better graphics and performance, but the game may not be playable on some VR headsets.
[/list]

We strongly recommend using the Beta channel if the game plays normally on your headset! Once we are sure that the new technology works on all VR headsets, we will publish the game from the Beta channel to the default game channel.

We really need your comments on how the app works on different devices to make a truly beautiful VR experience available to everyone!

How to switch between channels?
[olist]
[*] Find the "A Walk in the Woods" application in your library.
[*] Press the right mouse button or similar combination on the touchpad to show the context menu. Click on “Properties”.
[*] New window will appear. Go to the "Beta Versions" tab.
[*] In the drop-down list (the very first item), select the channel you want to use. "None" - to use the default channel and "Beta - ..." to enjoy the latest and greatest version of the game.
[/olist]

Have a great walk and take care of yourself and your loved ones!
Brightdawn Entertainment Team.

notes.title: Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
The game "A Walk in the Woods" was released a year ago. We've decided to celebrate this with the release of a major update that brings features to the game that our community has lacked the most. 

What's new?
1. We have updated the version of the game engine. This has resulted in stability and performance improvements. 
2. We've improved the lighting in the game. Now you can enjoy more realistic shadows and volumetrics effects.
3. We have rewritten input system from scratch. Using different input devices at the same time has become more smooth.
4. We've added in-game settings 
[list]
[*] Anti-aliasing options (No Anti-aliasing, FXAA, SMAA, TAA)
[*] Customizable Walking speed
[*] Choice between low and hight resolution of textures
[*] Choice between simple and advance lighting
[*] Support of Keyboard & Mouse
[/list]
5. Support of non-VR mode.

notes.title: “A Walk in the Woods” is now free
notes.notes:
Winter has come to the Northern Hemisphere. Days have turned gray and short and an already difficult time is further clouded by the COVID-19 pandemic.

We, at Brightdawn Entertainment, decided to somehow help people get through this difficult time, Starting December 1, the VR game “A Walk in the Woods” becomes free for everyone!

"A Walk in the Woods" was released on April 21, 2020. The product was originally suppose to be a VR arcade game, but the pandemic made some changes to our plans and we had to remake our realistic VR experience into a relaxation game, which became available to a wide audience for the price of a cup of coffee.

The game was fairly successful and collected 70% of positive reviews on Steam. We consider this to be a breakthrough considering the fact that the game lacks gameplay. Yes exactly! This game is about relaxation and exploration. In this game the player is invited to walk through the lost terrain and find all the Points of Interests, enjoy nature and just take a break from everyday worries in a high-quality virtual world.

At the time of quarantine, this is exactly what many people need! Many are forced to be isolated in their apartments amidst the gray city landscape. But sometimes you really want to find yourself in silence, enjoy the murmur of a stream, the singing of birds and summer sun. Alas, we cannot provide the feeling of warmth of the sun, but we can make you believe in the beauty of virtual nature. Attention to detail and sophistication of the plant world is a key feature of “A Walk in the Woods”.
We express our gratitude to all those who purchased the game and wrote a review on Steam. It really  means a lot to us. We will take all the experience gained during the development of this product into account  when developing our next projects.

Stay healthy and take care of yourself!
Best regards, 
Brightdown Entertainment.
